checks.label: Real administrator and two normal Jellyfin accounts authenticated
Create response is anonymous even for the author
Administrator sees their real name when creating a suggestion
Normal accounts see all existing and new proposals anonymously in both list orders
Administrator sees the stored names of every author
Reading as administrator does not leak names into subsequent normal-user responses
Vote and remove-vote responses are anonymous and retain vote state
Administrator sees the author when voting
Normal accounts cannot change status or delete suggestions
Closed suggestions remain anonymous and reject further votes
Unauthenticated clients cannot read board data
Normal account sees Anonym in embedded board
Administrator sees author names in embedded board
Reading old proposals preserves their stored names and exact record bytes

scope: Built plugin on isolated Jellyfin 12.4, real authentication and browser rendering
